title: Deutsche Bank helps shape Google Cloud’s new AI solution for financial services
summary: Deutsche Bank helps shape Google Cloud’s new AI solution for financial services
body_markdown:
## **Understanding the Financial Research Agent: Key questions answered**


### **What is the Financial Research Agent and how does it work?**


The Financial Research Agent is an AI-powered research solution designed specifically for financial services. The solution was developed through Deutsche Bank's design partnership with Google Cloud. It brings together market information, company data, financial performance indicators and other relevant sources to help employees complete complex research and analysis more efficiently. Using finance-specific personas and specialised skills, it can generate structured outputs such as client briefings, financial analyses and other research materials, helping teams move more quickly from information gathering to informed decision-making.


### **How is the Financial Research Agent different from a general-purpose AI assistant?**


Unlike general-purpose AI assistants, the Financial Research Agent has been built specifically for financial-services workflows. It combines finance-focused expertise, predefined roles and specialised skills with tools that can access and analyse relevant information sources in a controlled way. The solution is designed to produce consistent, traceable and auditable outputs, making it suitable for regulated business processes. Its architecture also allows organisations to adapt the solution for additional financial-services use cases, without having to build separate AI solutions from scratch.


### **How does this AI tool ensure data security and regulatory compliance in banking?**


The Financial Research Agent is designed for use in regulated financial environments. Deutsche Bank contributed requirements relating to security, governance, auditability, access controls and data residency as part of its role as a key design partner. The solution operates within existing permission structures, keeps sensitive information within secure environments and provides outputs linked to verifiable sources. It also includes enterprise-grade controls such as encryption, audit logging and access management features to support the responsible use of AI.


### **How will Deutsche Bank's clients benefit from this technology?**


Deutsche Bank will be using the Financial Research Agent initially with teams serving German MidCorp clients (medium-sized corporate clients) in the Corporate Bank. The solution is designed to help employees spend less time gathering and analysing information and more time applying their expertise to client needs. By bringing together company information, financial performance and market developments into structured insights, it can help bankers prepare more effectively, identify relevant opportunities earlier, have more informed client conversations and support better decision-making. Over time, Deutsche Bank expects to expand the technology to additional business areas, supporting stronger client relationships, more targeted solutions and better outcomes across a broader range of clients and services
